create_pointcloud_from_rgb_depth: create an Open3D point cloud from RGB and depth tensors using camera intrinsics and pose
create_mesh_from_rgb_depth: create a TriangleMesh from RGB and depth tensors with precomputed mesh topology and camera pose
compute_points_and_normals: compute 3D points, surface normals, and camera rays from a depth tensor and camera intrinsics matrix
convert_torch_tensor_to_open3d_image: convert a PyTorch RGB tensor to an Open3D image for visualization with optional point overlays
create_camera_trajectory_lineset: create an Open3D LineSet visualizing camera poses as a trajectory with optional frustum overlays
